title: AI Wedding Dress Try On
summary: Free AI wedding dress and veil try on: add one photo and see yourself in a ball gown, mermaid, slip or boho dress with a cathedral, birdcage or mantilla veil.
body_markdown:
### Is there a free AI wedding dress try on?


Yes. Flick is free to start: the free plan gives 100 credits every day with no credit card, and GPT Image 2.6, which made every try on on this page, costs 5 credits an edit.


### How do I try on wedding dresses virtually with AI?


Add a clear photo of yourself to an image edit model, describe one wedding dress and one veil, and ask it to keep your face, skin tone and hair exactly the same; then edit the original photo again for each new dress.


### Can I try on a wedding veil with AI?


Yes. Describe the veil by its length, such as birdcage, fingertip, chapel or cathedral, and say where it is pinned, and the model adds it to your photo; you can also ask for just a veil and keep the rest of the photo as it is.


### Will the AI keep my face the same?


Mostly. An image edit model redraws the whole picture, so details such as a beauty mark or the shape of a smile can drift; asking for the same face in the prompt and editing the original photo each time keeps the closest likeness.


### Can I try on a dress from a photo of the dress?


Yes. Add a photo of the dress as a second reference image and say that the dress comes from that image and the face from yours; GPT Image 2.6 takes up to 10 reference images.


### Which AI models can edit a photo into a wedding dress?


In Flick, image models that can edit a photo include GPT Image 2.6, Nano Banana Pro and Seedream 5.5; run the same prompt on two of them and keep the result that looks most like you.


### Is an AI try on accurate for fit and size?


An AI try on shows the style, not the fit: it does not measure your body, so treat it as a picture of the style, the neckline and the veil length on you, and leave fit and size to a fitting at the boutique.
